summary: Off-registry plain-HTTP dependency tarball enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares its sole dependency 'marker-script-suffix-mapper' as a plain-HTTP tarball URL on a non-registry host: http://web.vitemaweed.fr:4873/marker-script-suffix-mapper/-/marker-script-suffix-mapper-1.0.18.tgz. On npm install, npm fetches that URL and installs whatever bytes the host returns, running any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. There is no registry version resolution, no integrity hash, no TLS, and the upstream is mutable and controlled by a third party. The shipped index.js is a stub; the manifest itself is the attack surface, functioning as a redirector to an attacker-controlled tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
